newsitem.title: UK: Gen Accident aims to double premium income - paper.
newsitem.headline: Gen Accident aims to double premium income - paper.

text.p: British composite insurance group General Accident (GA) aims to double new premium income from sales of life assurance, pensions and investment products in the next three years and may make an acquisition to achieve this, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.

Executives at GA Life were finalising a business plan to provide the basis of the division's strategy now the integration of Provident Mutual, bought just over a year ago, was complete, said the newspaper.
It said the company was planning growth of 20-25 percent in new premium income this year. Organic growth would be the mainstay of the three-year expansion plans, but another purchase was possible.
The newspaper quoted assistant general manager Peter Hales as saying that "if a potential opportunity came along, we would consider it. If the right thing didn't, organic growth would go a long way."
